parameters.description:
`homeassistant-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native Home Assistant payload. The gateway composes the upstream Home Assistant URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters (the `accesstoken_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding this enrollment's Home Assistant long-lived access token).
parameters.summary: Relay a notification to your own Home Assistant by posting a native Home Assistant payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

accesstoken_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Home Assistant long-lived access token
